description: This file defines a Flutter widget class 'BusinessTab' that extends StatelessWidget. It builds a UI component that displays a category tab for business-related content, utilizing a 'CategoryTab' widget with a category parameter derived from application constants.

classes.name: BusinessTab
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the Business tab, which displays a category-specific tab view.

methods.name: build
